subject: Biology
student_question: Explain how blood flows through the chambers of the human heart and why the left ventricular wall is thicker.
verified_academic_evidence: Concise Biology Grade 10 (Selina Publishers), Chapter 7: Deoxygenated blood enters Right Atrium via Vena Cava -> Right Ventricle -> Pulmonary Artery to lungs. Oxygenated blood returns via Pulmonary Veins -> Left Atrium -> Left Ventricle -> Systemic Aorta to body tissues. Left Ventricle wall is 3x thicker to overcome systemic peripheral resistance.
desired_explanation: Blood flow follows double circulation: deoxygenated blood from the body enters the Right Atrium through superior and inferior vena cava, passes through the tricuspid valve into the Right Ventricle, and is pumped to the lungs via the Pulmonary Artery. Oxygenated blood from the lungs enters the Left Atrium through pulmonary veins, flows through the bicuspid (mitral) valve into the Left Ventricle, and is propelled into the Aorta. The Left Ventricle has the thickest muscular myocardium because it must generate high hydrostatic pressure to pump blood throughout systemic circulation.
correct_answer: Right Atrium -> Right Ventricle -> Lungs -> Left Atrium -> Left Ventricle -> Aorta; Left Ventricle is thicker to pump against systemic resistance.
common_incorrect_answer: Claiming pulmonary veins carry deoxygenated blood.
explanation_of_error: Pulmonary veins are the only veins in the adult human body carrying oxygenated blood from the lungs to the heart.

subject: Mathematics
student_question: Solve 2x² - 8x + 6 = 0 using the quadratic formula and state the nature of the roots.
verified_academic_evidence: Understanding ICSE Mathematics Grade 10 (M.L. Aggarwal / APC), Chapter 5: a=2, b=-8, c=6. D = b² - 4ac = (-8)² - 4(2)(6) = 64 - 48 = 16 > 0. Two distinct real roots: x = (-(-8) ± √16)/(2*2) = (8 ± 4)/4 => x=3, x=1.
desired_explanation: Standard form: 2x² - 8x + 6 = 0. Identify a = 2, b = -8, c = 6. Calculate Discriminant D = b² - 4ac = 16. Since D > 0 and a perfect square, roots are real, rational, and distinct. x = (8 ± 4)/4 gives x = 3 and x = 1.

visual_specification.format: SVG Parabola Graph with roots at x=1, x=3

correct_answer: x = 1, x = 3; Real and distinct roots.
explanation_of_error: Denominator of the quadratic formula is 2a (2*2 = 4), not 2.

subject: History
student_question: Explain the immediate cause of the 1857 uprising and its administrative consequences under the Act of 1858.
verified_academic_evidence: Total History & Civics Grade 10 (Morning Star), Chapter 1: Introduction of Enfield P-53 greased cartridge bit with teeth. Act of 1858 transferred East India Company rule to the British Crown, created Viceroy and Secretary of State.
desired_explanation: Immediate Cause: Enfield P-53 rifle cartridges greased with cow and pig fat, offending Hindu and Muslim sepoys, culminating in Mangal Pandey's revolt at Barrackpore on March 29, 1857. Consequences: Government of India Act 1858 abolished East India Company rule, transferred authority directly to the British Crown, created the office of Secretary of State for India, and designated the Governor-General as Viceroy.
correct_answer: Greased Enfield cartridge; transfer of power from Company to Crown under 1858 Act.
common_incorrect_answer: Claiming the revolt was caused only by Doctrine of Lapse.
explanation_of_error: Doctrine of Lapse was an underlying political cause; the immediate spark was the Enfield greased cartridge.

subject: Physics
student_question: An object is placed at 2F₁ in front of a convex lens. State image position, nature, and magnification with a ray diagram.
verified_academic_evidence: Concise Physics Grade 10 (Selina Publishers), Chapter 5: Object at 2F₁ forms image at 2F₂. Nature is Real and Inverted. Size is same as object, magnification m = -1.
desired_explanation: When an object is placed at 2F₁ of a convex lens, refracted rays converge at 2F₂ on the opposite side. The image formed is Real and Inverted, of the exact same size as the object (linear magnification m = -1).

visual_specification.format: SVG Ray Optics Diagram with parallel ray and optical center ray intersection

correct_answer: Image at 2F₂; Real and Inverted; m = -1.
common_incorrect_answer: Image at F₂; Virtual and Erect.
explanation_of_error: Object at infinity forms image at F₂; only object between O and F₁ forms a virtual image.

subject: Chemistry
student_question: Explain coordinate bonding in the Hydronium ion (H3O+) with an electron dot diagram.
verified_academic_evidence: Concise Chemistry Grade 10 (Selina Publishers), Chapter 2: Water molecule (H2O) has two lone pairs on Oxygen. One lone pair is donated to a bare H+ ion to form H3O+ with one coordinate covalent bond.
desired_explanation: A coordinate bond is formed when the shared electron pair is provided entirely by one atom. In H₂O, Oxygen has two lone pairs. When an H⁺ ion (lacking electrons) approaches, Oxygen donates one lone pair, forming a coordinate bond represented as O ⎯→ H⁺, resulting in the stable hydronium ion H₃O⁺.

visual_specification.format: SVG Electron Dot Diagram showing lone pair donation

correct_answer: Oxygen donates lone pair to H⁺; bond indicated by arrow O ⎯→ H⁺.
common_incorrect_answer: Claiming H3O+ is formed by electrovalent transfer of an electron.
explanation_of_error: Electrons are shared, not transferred; both electrons in the dative bond originate from Oxygen.

subject: Geography
student_question: Explain the difference between 4-figure and 6-figure grid references with an example from sheet 45D/7.
verified_academic_evidence: Total Geography Grade 10 (Morning Star), Chapter 1: 4-figure locates a 1km x 1km grid square (Easting, Northing). 6-figure pinpoints an exact location to within 100m by dividing tenths.
desired_explanation: A 4-figure grid reference identifies an entire 1 km² grid square using two Easting digits followed by two Northing digits (e.g. 2485). A 6-figure grid reference pinpoints an exact spot to within 100 meters by dividing the grid square into tenths along Eastings and Northings (e.g. 243857).
common_incorrect_answer: Putting Northing numbers before Easting numbers.
explanation_of_error: Eastings (vertical grid lines numbered west to east) must ALWAYS be read before Northings (horizontal lines numbered south to north).

subject: Civics / Political Science
student_question: State the composition of the Lok Sabha and explain why Money Bills can only originate in Lok Sabha.
verified_academic_evidence: Total History & Civics Grade 10 (Morning Star), Chapter 12: Lok Sabha maximum strength 550. Under Article 109, Money Bills can only be introduced in Lok Sabha on presidential recommendation because it directly represents the tax-paying citizens.
desired_explanation: The Lok Sabha has a maximum elective strength of 550 members representing States and Union Territories. Under Article 109 of the Constitution of India, Money Bills can ONLY be introduced in the Lok Sabha with prior recommendation of the President because the Lok Sabha is the directly elected chamber accountable to the taxpayers.
correct_answer: Max 550 members; Money bills originate only in Lok Sabha under Article 109.
common_incorrect_answer: Believing Rajya Sabha can reject a Money Bill.
explanation_of_error: Rajya Sabha cannot reject or amend a Money Bill; it can only make recommendations within 14 days, which the Lok Sabha may reject.

subject: English I
student_question: Rewrite the sentence beginning with 'No sooner': 'As soon as the teacher entered, the class became silent.'
verified_academic_evidence: Total English Grade 10 (Morning Star), Chapter 3: 'No sooner did the teacher enter than the class became silent.' Inversion of auxiliary verb with 'than'.
desired_explanation:
Rule: 'As soon as' is replaced by 'No sooner'. An auxiliary verb ('did' for past tense or 'had') must immediately follow 'No sooner' before the subject (syntactic inversion). The connecting conjunction must be 'than'.
Result: 'No sooner did the teacher enter than the class became silent.'
correct_answer: No sooner did the teacher enter than the class became silent.
common_incorrect_answer: No sooner did the teacher enter when the class became silent.

subject: English II
student_question: Explain Portia's speech on 'The quality of mercy' in Act IV Scene 1 and its dramatic significance.
verified_academic_evidence: The Merchant of Venice (Verity Edition / Morning Star): Portia states mercy is not strained; it drops as the gentle rain from heaven upon the place beneath. It blesses him that gives and him that takes.
desired_explanation: In Act IV Scene 1, disguised as Balthazar, Portia delivers the famous plea for mercy to Shylock. She explains that mercy cannot be forced ('not strained'); it flows freely like gentle rain from heaven. It is twice blessed: it ennobles both the person who shows mercy and the person who receives it, reflecting divine justice above earthly power.
correct_answer: Mercy is unstrained, divine attribute twice blessed; delivered by Portia in Act IV Scene 1.
common_incorrect_answer: Claiming Antonio delivers the speech to save himself.
explanation_of_error: Portia (as the legal doctor Balthazar) delivers the speech while Antonio stands silently prepared to forfeit his bond.

subject: Computer Science
student_question: Explain the difference between Linear Search and Binary Search in Java with time complexities.
verified_academic_evidence: Understanding Computer Applications with BlueJ (APC), Chapter 7: Linear Search checks element by element sequentially (O(n)), works on unsorted arrays. Binary Search requires sorted array, repeatedly halves search space (O(log n)).
desired_explanation: Linear Search traverses an array sequentially from index 0 to n-1 until the target is found or end is reached; time complexity is O(n), and the array does not need to be sorted. Binary Search requires a monotonically sorted array; it compares the target to the middle element (mid = low + (high - low)/2) and eliminates half the array each step, yielding O(log n) time complexity.
correct_answer: Linear Search: O(n), unsorted OK; Binary Search: O(log n), sorted array required.
common_incorrect_answer: Using Binary Search on an unsorted array.
explanation_of_error: Binary Search logic relies entirely on ordering to discard half the search space; unsorted arrays produce false negative results.
